# Fixture for PERF-PY-27 (vulnerable): same path loaded repeatedly in a loop
lang: python
file: app/summarize_runs.py
---
from pathlib import Path

REPORT_PATH = Path("/var/log/myapp/latest.txt")

def summarize(user_ids):
    runs = []
    for user_id in user_ids:
        text = REPORT_PATH.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
        runs.append((user_id, text))
    return runs
